## Summary

I work in corporate banking at Bank SinoPac's Los Angeles Branch, where I support U.S. corporate credit and syndicated loan transactions. My day-to-day work covers financial statement analysis, credit risk monitoring, and preparing bilingual credit memos for the Credit Committee and Head Office in Taiwan.

Before banking, I built my foundation in accounting (B.S., Northern Illinois University) and business analytics (M.S., UC San Diego). I use SQL, Python, and Excel to turn financial and operational data into clear decisions, and I have a track record of replacing manual, error-prone processes with automated checks.
